AutocompleteText inputs

The `m3e-autocomplete` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3eelbuildHTML
[ M3e.formField []
[ M3e.FormField.label (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "fruit" ] [ Kit.text "Choose your favorite fruit" ])
, TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "id" "fruit" ] []
]
, M3e.autocomplete [ M3e.Autocomplete.for "fruit" ]
…
[ M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Apples" ]
, M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Oranges" ]
, M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Bananas" ]
, M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Grapes" ]
]
]
[ M3e.FormField.view []
[ M3e.FormField.label (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "fruit" ] [ Kit.text "Choose your favorite fruit" ])
, TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "id" "fruit" ] []
]
, M3e.Autocomplete.view [ M3e.Autocomplete.for "fruit" ]
…
[ M3e.Option.el { content = Kit.text "Apples" } [] []
, M3e.Option.el { content = Kit.text "Oranges" } [] []
, M3e.Option.el { content = Kit.text "Bananas" } [] []
, M3e.Option.el { content = Kit.text "Grapes" } [] []
]
]
[ M3e.FormField.build
|> M3e.FormField.withLabel (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "fruit" ] [ Kit.text "Choose your favorite fruit" ])
|> M3e.FormField.withChild (TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "id" "fruit" ] [])
|> M3e.FormField.toElement
, M3e.Autocomplete.build
|> M3e.Autocomplete.withFor "fruit"
|> M3e.Autocomplete.withChild (M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Apples" ])
|> M3e.Autocomplete.withChild (M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Oranges" ])
|> M3e.Autocomplete.withChild (M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Bananas" ])
|> M3e.Autocomplete.withChild (M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Grapes" ])
|> M3e.Autocomplete.toElement
]
<m3e-form-field>
<label slot="label" for="fruit">Choose your favorite fruit</label>
<input id="fruit">
</m3e-form-field>
<m3e-autocomplete for="fruit">
…
<m3e-option>Apples</m3e-option>
<m3e-option>Oranges</m3e-option>
<m3e-option>Bananas</m3e-option>
<m3e-option>Grapes</m3e-option>
</m3e-autocomplete>

Initial load

M3eelbuildHTML
[ M3e.formField []
[ M3e.FormField.label (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "state" ] [ Kit.text "State" ])
, TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "id" "state" ] []
]
, M3e.autocomplete
[ M3e.Attributes.class "lazy"
, M3e.Autocomplete.for "state"
]
[ M3e.Autocomplete.loading (M3e.loadingIndicator [] []) ]
]

el is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the el surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for el on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

[ M3e.FormField.build
|> M3e.FormField.withLabel (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "state" ] [ Kit.text "State" ])
|> M3e.FormField.withChild (TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "id" "state" ] [])
|> M3e.FormField.toElement
, M3e.Autocomplete.view
[ M3e.Attributes.class "lazy"
, M3e.Autocomplete.for "state"
]
[ M3e.Autocomplete.loading
(M3e.LoadingIndicator.build
|> M3e.LoadingIndicator.toElement
)
]
]
<m3e-form-field>
<label slot="label" for="state">State</label>
<input id="state">
</m3e-form-field>
<m3e-autocomplete class="lazy" for="state">
<m3e-loading-indicator slot="loading"></m3e-loading-indicator>
</m3e-autocomplete>

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.Autocomplete.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Autocomplete.Content (M3e.Component.Autocomplete.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.Autocomplete.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children].

type Is

The kind row m3e-autocomplete produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Filter

The filter values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

loading : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named loading slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

noData : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named no-data slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

child : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Autocomplete.Content admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place a pre-built element into the default (unnamed) slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list). The list-form sibling of the builder's withChild.
